h: Pastor Adeboye's blessing for his granddaughter on her wedding day stirs emotions
p: RCCG General Overseer Pastor Enoch Adeboye has drawn warm reactions online over the blessing he gave his granddaughter on her wedding day. Videos from the ceremony are circulating widely, with many users sharing congratulatory messages to the family.
more: Guests included church leaders and family friends.
Clips of the prayer have been reposted thousands of times.
